stemMarkdown:
"The new bridge will reduce traffic congestion, because it provides drivers with a second route into the city."

The argument assumes that:

options.markdown: a meaningful number of drivers will actually use the new route
the bridge was completed within its original budget
the existing route is the oldest road into the city
congestion is the most serious problem facing the city

solutionMarkdown: Apply the negation test. If no drivers use the new route, the bridge cannot reduce congestion and the argument collapses — so this is a **necessary assumption**. Negating any other option leaves the argument intact, so none of them is assumed.
